At.description: A UTC time to the millisecond, such as 2026-11-17T15:04:05.123Z.

Closes.description:
The summary of the segment an index line closes. The segment's file stays the truth: `journal
check` compares the two and states any difference.

parts.description:
The parts its events concern, each by its id with its name, `<song>/<part>`, beside it,
sorted by name.

songs.description: The songs its events concern, each by its id with its name beside it, sorted by name.

takes.description: The takes its events concern, by name and digest.

to.description: When its last entry was written.

IndexHead.description:
`journal-index` 1.0's first line holds the head: the project's name, and the journal's own
id, made when it was started.

project.description: The name of the project whose journal this is.

IndexLine.description:
One index line: it opens a segment, and, after the first, closes the one before it, in one
write (bus design decision 21).

Indexed.description:
A song or a part as the index names it: its stable id, with its name beside it for reading
(bus design decision 17, the domain model's ruling 13). A part's name is `<song>/<part>`.

The id is absent only when no event named one: a document written in a song's folder that
holds no song that reads, or a part that states no id, such as a drum grid. Such an entry
is found by its name alone.

Opens.description: The segment an index line opens.

id.description: Its id, as its head names it.

segment.description: Its stamp, which names its file.

SegmentStamp.description: A segment's first moment, UTC to the millisecond in ISO 8601 basic form, such as 20261117T150405123Z. Its file is journal.<stamp>.duet.jsonl.

TakeDigest.description: The SHA-256 of a take's decoded samples: the bytes `duet-take-1`, the rate as a little-endian u32, the channel count as a little-endian u16, then every sample, interleaved, as the little-endian bits of its f32.

TakeRef.description: A take as the index names it: its name and its digest, never a path.
